{
  "subtype": "exploratory_data_analysis",
  "focus_variable": "state_declined",
  "per_column": [
    {
      "name": "asset_category",
      "role": "predictor",
      "is_predictor": true,
      "is_interpretable_segmentation": true,
      "rationale": "Well-separated, interpretable categories of expense type; directly supports discovering which kinds of expenses get declined, the core of the query."
    },
    {
      "name": "procurement_action_type",
      "role": "predictor",
      "is_predictor": true,
      "is_interpretable_segmentation": true,
      "rationale": "Interpretable process-stage categories that can be segmented on and compared against decline rates; associational and external to the focus."
    },
    {
      "name": "entry_origin",
      "role": "predictor",
      "is_predictor": true,
      "is_interpretable_segmentation": true,
      "rationale": "Clean binary (manual vs auto) with meaningful balance; a plausible driver of declines and easy to compare across departments."
    },
    {
      "name": "ci_id_quality",
      "role": "predictor",
      "is_predictor": true,
      "is_interpretable_segmentation": true,
      "rationale": "Interpretable data-quality tiers with reasonable spread; poor/placeholder identifiers could associate with declines, an informative relationship."
    },
    {
      "name": "asset_brand",
      "role": "predictor",
      "is_predictor": true,
      "is_interpretable_segmentation": true,
      "rationale": "Distinct, human-readable brand categories that can be grouped and compared against decline rates."
    },
    {
      "name": "is_travel_related",
      "role": "predictor",
      "is_predictor": true,
      "is_interpretable_segmentation": true,
      "rationale": "Binary flag with meaningful split; travel vs non-travel is a natural, interpretable segment for exploring declines by department."
    },
    {
      "name": "has_source_id",
      "role": "predictor",
      "is_predictor": true,
      "is_interpretable_segmentation": true,
      "rationale": "Interpretable binary presence indicator with a usable split; missing source linkage could associate with declines."
    }
  ],
  "n_predictors": 7,
  "relationship_informativeness": 0.85,
  "rationale": "The added columns are all external, associational variables with interpretable, well-separated categories or clean binaries, none of which merely restate the state_declined focus. asset_category, is_travel_related, and asset_brand directly enable segmenting 'what kinds of expenses get declined,' while entry_origin, ci_id_quality, and has_source_id surface data-provenance/quality hypotheses that can each be cross-tabulated with department. Categories have usable spread (no near-constant or hyper-fine-grained fields), making them well suited to human-driven relationship discovery. Slight deduction because several columns (procurement_action_type dominated by one value, has_source_id, ci_id_quality) are somewhat process/metadata oriented and moderately imbalanced, limiting comparative power, but as a set they strongly support the exploratory intent."
}
